body:
Goal: add .github/workflows/docs.yml and .github/dependabot.yml exactly per spec §8. docs.yml only verifies (gen-check, build, link check); it has NO deploy job — the Vercel GitHub integration deploys production from main and previews per PR (§8.1). This PR requires owner CODEOWNERS review (D6); you open it, you never merge it, and you never change repository or Vercel settings or handle Vercel tokens.

Do:
1. docs.yml: workflow-level permissions: {}. Jobs: gen-check (contents: read; triggers and paths listed in §8 incl. dist/**, vendor/**, CONTRIBUTING.md, CHANGELOG.md, website/**, .github/workflows/docs.yml; setup-node with node-version-file website/.nvmrc, no npm install; runs node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check, node website/scripts/check-all.mjs, node --test website/scripts/test/); changes (contents: read; checkout fetch-depth 0; git diff --name-only between base and head sets output docs=true for website/**, docs/**, root *.md, .github/workflows/docs.yml, always true on push to main); build (needs changes, if docs=='true', contents: read; checkout fetch-depth 0; setup-node with cache npm and cache-dependency-path website/package-lock.json; in website: npm ci, npm run build, npm run lint:links, npm run check:site, node scripts/check-ia.mjs; nothing uploaded). No deploy job, no configure-pages/upload-pages-artifact/deploy-pages, no environment:, no id-token/pages/deployments permissions, no Vercel CLI or token. Every uses: pinned to a 40-char SHA with a "# vX.Y.Z" comment (resolve SHAs with gh api repos/<owner>/<action>/git/ref/tags/<tag>). No secrets.* references.
2. .github/dependabot.yml: npm for /website weekly, all grouped into one PR; github-actions for / weekly, grouped.
3. Do not modify ci.yml, adlc-rails-guard.yml, publish.yml, release-drift.yml.
4. PR description includes the owner checklist from §8/§8.1: create the Vercel project and connect this repo via the Vercel GitHub integration; grant the Vercel GitHub app access to this repository only (trust note: it reads contents and writes statuses/deployments/PR comments; no secrets); Root Directory = website/, Node.js 22.x (Vercel resolves it from website/package.json engines.node 22.x, which overrides the dashboard), production branch main, default npm ci / npm run build; Ignored Build Step = `git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- .`; the Vercel check is never made a required status check; no vercel.json and no env vars; decide whether gen-check becomes required; confirm AC33 (Vercel preview check on a website/ PR) and AC34 (attestation with screenshots/build-log Node line, plus the deployments/<id>/statuses success query); after main deploys, record DOCS_URL in spec D8 and website/README.md and confirm AC28.

Do not edit code, bundles, AGENTS.md or website/ (AC3, AC23).

Context: repo antigravity-booster (agb), plugin v1.0.0. Spec: .adlc/specs/docs-site.md (revision 3: Vercel hosting, default Next.js server output) — read it first; section references below point into it. Use Node >= 22.19.0. Work on a branch off origin/main; never push to or merge into main (merge is the owner's decision).

Hard constraints: never modify .adlc/config.json (including acknowledgedNewRailBypass / trustedCodeownersAttested), lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs or CODEOWNERS (these are this ticket's rails). 

Base / prerequisites: website/ does not exist at origin/main 4864376. Start only after T-DOCS-SCAFFOLD and T-DOCS-GEN is merged to main, then branch off the updated origin/main (not 4864376). If it is not merged yet, stop and report; do not scaffold or create check scripts yourself. 
Resolved ambiguities:
- Triggers: workflow-level `on.pull_request.paths` and `on.push` (branches [main]) paths are the union of the §8 gen-check list and the build list (docs/**, *.md). gen-check gets its own gate: reuse the `changes` job to also emit `code=true` when a gen-check path changed (always true on push to main); gen-check has `needs: changes` and `if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'`.
- `changes` job: checkout with fetch-depth 0; on push (or when github.event.before is all zeros) skip the diff and set both outputs true. If the git diff command fails for any reason, set both outputs true (fail open toward running the jobs).
- Action versions: latest release tag of each (actions/checkout, actions/setup-node) at time of writing. Resolve with `gh api repos/actions/<name>/releases/latest --jq .tag_name`, then `gh api repos/actions/<name>/git/ref/tags/<tag>`; if object.type is "tag", dereference via `gh api repos/actions/<name>/git/tags/<sha> --jq .object.sha`. Comment is the full tag `# vX.Y.Z`.
- dependabot.yml: version 2; npm `/website` weekly (monday), groups `website: {patterns: ["*"]}`; github-actions `/` weekly (monday), groups `actions: {patterns: ["*"]}`; open-pull-requests-limit 5. It will propose bumps to other workflows; that is intended and those PRs are reviewed separately (AC27 applies only to docs PRs).
- AC28 = `curl -sfo /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$DOCS_URL/docs"` prints 200, with DOCS_URL the Vercel production URL the owner records (spec D8, §11). It is an owner gate for ROOT-SLIM, not part of this PR's verification.
- Dependabot has no Vercel role; Vercel builds dependency PRs as previews automatically.
- YAML lint: use `actionlint` if installed, otherwise `npx --yes yaml@2 valid < .github/workflows/docs.yml` (network allowed for this step); pass = exit 0.
- Branch: docs/ci.

Operational notes:
- Run commands from the repo root; lines beginning `cd website &&` run in a subshell, e.g. `(cd website && npm ci)`.
- `npm test` is the required gate. `unshare -r -n npm test` is informational: run it if user namespaces are available and paste the output; if unsupported, say so. `cd website && npm ci` needs network and is not run under unshare.
- AC30 `gate-manifest record` writes .adlc/manifest.jsonl, which is untracked at 4864376: do not commit it; paste the `verify` output. If record fails for environmental reasons (e.g. missing ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY), paste the error; it is an audit gate and does not block the PR (AGENTS.md degrade rule).
- The follow-up chore PR touches only .adlc/tickets/ and .adlc/ticket-archive/ (ticket complete/archive); it is not part of this ticket's scope.

Verification (run each, show output in the PR description):
- npm test (root suite passes; spec AC1, also try: unshare -r -n npm test)
- git diff --quiet origin/main -- .adlc/config.json; echo $?   -> 0 (AC29)
- npx adlc rails-guard --base origin/main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs --rails .adlc/config.json --rails CODEOWNERS; echo $?   -> 0 (AC22)
- npm test && npx adlc gate-manifest record tests --ticket T-DOCS-CI && npx adlc gate-manifest verify; echo $?   -> 0 (AC30)

- AC26 commands from spec §11: grep -E "uses: " .github/workflows/docs.yml | grep -vcE "@[0-9a-f]{40} # v" -> 0; grep -c "secrets\." -> 0; grep -cE "id-token|pages: write|deployments:|configure-pages|upload-pages-artifact|deploy-pages|environment:|vercel" -> 0; grep -c "contents: read" -> 3
- git diff --quiet origin/main -- .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/adlc-rails-guard.yml .github/workflows/publish.yml .github/workflows/release-drift.yml; echo $?   -> 0 (AC27)
- node -e "require('fs').readFileSync('.github/workflows/docs.yml','utf8')" plus a YAML lint (npx --yes yaml-lint or actionlint if installed) -> no errors
- git diff --quiet origin/main -- lib bin mcp hooks sidecars scripts dist vendor website AGENTS.md; echo $?   -> 0

Finish: open a PR (not merged by you). After merge, in a follow-up chore PR, run npx adlc ticket complete T-DOCS-CI --write --authorize then npx adlc ticket archive T-DOCS-CI --write --authorize (AC31). Archive this ticket after merge.
title: Add the docs.yml verification workflow (no deploy; Vercel deploys) and Dependabot config (owner review)
